parsed.title: Inconsistent command for plan-from-issue
parsed.detail: The script claims `plan-from-issue` is a valid route in the header (line 16) and the `ROUTES` constant (line 35), but when a tracked issue is found (line 248), it uses the command `/plan-fix ${clean}`. However, for a `replan` route (line 265), it uses `/plan-fix ${unit.number}` for fixes and `/plan-feature ${unit.slug}` for features. The `plan-from-issue` route lacks a corresponding command pattern in the logic, and the `print` function will fail if `route` is not in `ROUTES`, but `plan-from-issue` is in `ROUTES` while the logic for `execute` (line 274) uses `/execute-phase ${unit.slug}`. There is a mismatch between the intended route name and the command structure for issues.
